description: Gold notes whose diagnoses are absent from or poorly represented in the ICD-10 code table. Purpose: measure the rate of correct NO_CONFIDENT_MATCH abstentions (SOW 8.4b).
sow_requirement: Section 3.9: 'A rare-diagnosis set of at least 10 notes whose diagnoses are absent from or poorly represented in the code table.' Section 8.4b: 'correct no confident match on at least 80% of the rare-diagnosis set.'
excluded_from_candidates: peptic ulcer disease (codes cleanly to K27.9)
polyps, cancer (generic terms with clean ICD coverage)
